answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one daily bidding slot. Agents can bid to inspect a jetty, track a comet, or map a ridge, but every extra identity needs its own bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 daily slots must immobilize $100,000 for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital. Creating new names cannot bypass the deposit requirement.
